latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Screen Record Free — Record, Edit, and Export Videos:

- Upload, edit, and export screen recordings (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM up to 500MB) directly in the cloud.
- Recordings are processed, edited, and exported as 1080p MP4 videos on remote GPU servers; no desktop software needed.
- Automatic handling of API sessions, authentication (including free token generation), and cloud render pipeline.
- Supports essential actions: upload, edit (trim, add captions, etc.), preview timeline, export, and check credits or job state.
- Simple, guided prompts for students, educators, remote workers, and anyone needing fast screen capture editing for free.
